停止与标签的斗争。开始指挥你的角色。 大多数模型的工作流程

展示：https://civitai.com/posts/25739743

此工作流程使用 ComfyUI-Persona-Director 自定义节点来锁定您的角色身份逻辑，不是运气。

与严重依赖 IP 适配器或严格 LoRA 的传统方法不同，此工作流程使用语义状态管理器让你的角色的“DNA”（头发、眼睛、标志性配饰）在各种不同的场景中保持持久——从赛博朋克城市到白雪皑皑的街道。

主要特点：

  • 0% 幻觉：保持配件（如演示中的蓝色星形夹）一致。

  • 无需 LoRA：通过结构化提示逻辑进行工作。

  • 跨模型就绪：测试于小马V6XL和新星动漫 XL，但该逻辑适用于大多数 SDXL 型号。

  • 复杂场景：处理剧烈的环境变化而不破坏角色。

如何运行此工作流程：

安装节点：转到 ComfyUI/custom_nodes 文件夹并克隆存储库：git clonehttps://github.com/18yz153/ComfyUI-Persona-Director（或者直接通过 ComfyUI Manager 安装）。

这是工作流程 PNG。您还可以在 GitHub 的资产中找到工作流程。

o.en:
Stop fighting with tags. Start directing your character. Workflow for most of the Models

Showcase:https://civitai.com/posts/25739743

This workflow uses the ComfyUI-Persona-Director custom node to lock your character's identity usingLogic, not luck.

Unlike traditional methods that rely heavily on IP-Adapters or rigid LoRAs, this workflow uses aSemantic State Managerto keep your character's "DNA" (hair, eyes, signature accessories) persistent across wildly different scenes—from Cyberpunk cities to snowy streets.

Key Features:

  • 0% Hallucination:Keeps accessories (like the blue star clip in the demo) consistent.

  • No LoRA Needed:Works via structured prompting logic.

  • Cross-Model Ready:Tested onPony V6 XLandNova Anime XL, but the logic works on most SDXL models.

  • Complex Scenes:Handles drastic environment changes without breaking the character.

How to run this workflow:

Install the Node: Go to your ComfyUI/custom_nodes folder and clone the repo: git clonehttps://github.com/18yz153/ComfyUI-Persona-Director(Or simply install via ComfyUI Manager).

Here is the workflow PNG. Also you can find the workflow in assets in GitHub.
